# UNCANNY

Current candidate: v0.20.0-alpha.2 — Final Alpha — ELYSIUM Engine 4.5
Exact private candidate: 748f80b6a63f64bc811479b185e00dc45d34c373
Validation run: 35683346915

Verified controlled evidence: source-bounded detail/noise governor; conservative water recovery; restricted D3D11 rigid geometry replacement; normal-only recovery; isolated material targeting/restoration; x86/x64 production builds.

Material fixture: 65536 target pixels pink; 65536 unrelated pixels unchanged; exact restoration.
Geometry fixture: 48 -> 120 triangles; independent silhouette-reference error 4464 -> 3816 pixels.

No real-game run was part of this exact candidate. Do not describe controlled fixture results as real-game certification.
Universal auto-tessellation, animated replacement, automatic rock/gravel displacement and universal DLSS 5 are not claimed.

UNCANNY is closed source. The public repository/package does not contain the private development tree.
